history.summary: Freehold new launch (2028 TOP) 3BR at Boon Keng for $2.34M / $2,415 PSF, a discount to the $2,656 project median, 500m from Boon Keng MRT. Freehold city-fringe with NEL access is attractive, but it's an unbuilt new launch with no resale appreciation history and the rate carries new-launch bias.
history.rating_rationale: Genuine positives: freehold (rare for a new launch), 500m to Boon Keng MRT (NEL, near CBD/Novena), a right-sized 969sqft 3BR at $2.34M in the liquid band, and an asking PSF (2415) below the $2,656 project median. But there is no resale-to-resale appreciation data (null rate), new-launch bias is flagged, and TOP is 2028 — so a 5-7yr hold doesn't start clearing SSD until ~2031+ and entry is at full launch pricing. Freehold floor and location keep it from Avoid; lack of proven growth and launch-premium entry keep it from Buy.
red_flags: Unbuilt new launch (2028 TOP) — no resale track record, new-launch-bias flagged
Entry at launch pricing; $2,415 PSF is rich for city-fringe even with freehold
Long runway before SSD-clear resale (hold effectively starts post-2028)
catalysts: Freehold tenure in a city-fringe RCR district — rare for a new launch
500m to Boon Keng MRT (NEL) — strong connectivity to CBD/Novena
Discount to the $2,656 project median asking PSF
Brand-new unit with full warranty/no lease decay

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Boon Keng is a strong rental belt (NEL, near CBD/hospitals); a new freehold 3BR will rent well on completion, though yield is compressed at $2,415 PSF.
